package.name: usv_radio_bridge
package.description: RFD900x serial telemetry-radio bridge to the ground-station GUI. Binary framed TX/RX on a dedicated reader thread with a priority-ordered TX queue, replacing ARACPC/navi_vehicle/navi_gui's Python telemetry_sender.py reference with an idiomatic rclcpp node (smaller telemetry payload, no JSON command payloads, and GUI-driven autonomy mode arbitration against usv_gnc's mode_mux_node). Never a required dependency for autonomous operation — see usv_bringup.launch.py's radio_bridge:=false argument.
